Research Question: Can13 historical training preference candidates support a causally valid policy-token-only DPO integrity probe?
Hypothesis: Semantically reviewed whole trajectories can supply bounded offline preference data; no capability gain claimed.
Independent Variable: CPU review/admission only; proposed later S1+DPO versus S1+chosen-only SFT.
Controlled Variables: Existing task/prompt/tools/state, original source records,8192tokenizer, no dev/final/BFCL content for training.
Metrics: Fresh replay equality, semantic dispositions, complete target masks, branch lengths, DPO scalar/chain-rule controls, source/reference identity.
Evidence Gate: Same initial context/state; reward and observation replay equal; completed branches; whole chosen reviewed; no infra failure; no fabricated observations.
Cost Bound: Local CPU only; no remote startup/GPU/API/model download/parameter updates.
Failure Branch: Preserve immutable invalid preparation record; fix only new prep path; no raw data editing or truncation.
